prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up, shallow depth-of-field photograph capturing the intimate moment of pouring hot water from a shiny metal kettle into a traditional yerba mate gourd. The focus is on a hand holding the ornate, silver-rimmed gourd, with a metal bombilla (straw) already inserted. The hand is adorned with a delicate ring and has a small tattoo on the wrist, adding a personal touch. The person wears a teal or green long-sleeve garment, which provides a soft, colorful contrast to the reflective metallic surfaces. The background is softly blurred, suggesting an outdoor setting with hints of natural colors—greens and browns—evoking a calm, relaxed atmosphere. The lighting is natural and diffused, highlighting the gleam of the metal and the texture of the hand, creating a warm, inviting mood. The composition is intimate and cinematic, with a tight crop that draws attention to the ritualistic act and the tactile details of the scene.
